# Camera

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/camera.h`](../../../src/logic/components/camera.h)

## Summary

Free-flying desktop camera: position, yaw, pitch and projection parameters.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by PlayerControlSys::preinit and driven by it (FixedCamera, SphereView, RollerPlayer also write it). yaw 0 looks toward -Z; forward() / right() / getView() derive from position, yaw, pitch; getProjection(aspect) is Vulkan clip space (depth 0..1, Y flipped). Read by ClassicRender, TerrainSys, ChunkManagerSys (load centre) and ChunkGeneratorSys (priority centre), DebugMenu, Capture.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 150, 0) | world units |
| `yaw` | `float` | 0 | radians, 0 looks toward -Z |
| `pitch` | `float` | -0.4 | radians |
| `fov` | `float` | radians(70) | vertical field of view |
| `near_plane` | `float` | 0.1 | world units |
| `far_plane` | `float` | 3000 | world units |
| `sprinting` | `bool` | false | PlayerControl sprint state |
